claims: The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony takes place Friday, April 17, 2026.
The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony takes place at 9 p.m. PT/midnight ET.
The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony takes place at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas.
The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony precedes WrestleMania 42.
AJ Styles is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
Stephanie McMahon is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
Demolition (Ax and Smash) is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
Sid Vicious is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
Bad News Brown is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
Dennis Rodman is a 2026 WWE Hall of Fame inductee.
AJ Styles is a decorated Grand Slam Champion.
Stephanie McMahon is a former WWE CEO.
Demolition (Ax and Smash) are long-reigning tag team champions.
Sid Vicious (Sid Justice/Psycho Sid) is a two-time WWE and WCW Champion.
Dennis Rodman is a celebrity inductee.
Hulk Hogan vs. Andre the Giant (WrestleMania III) is the Immortal Moment Inductee.
The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony airs live on ESPN Unlimited in the United States.
The WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony airs on WWE YouTube channel internationally.
Tickets for the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ceremony are available through Ticketmaster.
